payload.reason: The evidence indicates that while many industrial dialogue systems still rely on rule-based approaches, there is a trend towards using hybrid models that combine retrieval and trainable units, suggesting a move away from purely off-the-shelf NLP systems.

claims.text: Many industrially deployed dialogue systems still use manual features or handcrafted rules, indicating limited use of off-the-shelf NLP systems.
Hybrid models are replacing established rule- and template-based approaches, suggesting a shift towards more advanced NLP systems.
